en_title: Melissa Barrera Says She Would Reprise Her Scream Role, Reveals Conditions for Her Return
cn_title: Melissa Barrera愿回归《惊声尖叫》，但有条件
subtitle: 版权换手再谈
opus_summary: Melissa Barrera表示，只要Spyglass Media持有《惊声尖叫》版权，她就不会回归。若版权交由更尊重韦斯·克雷文遗产的新管理层，她愿意考虑再次出演。

paragraphs.en: Actress Melissa Barrera said she is open to returning to Scream, but don't expect to see her reprise her role as Sam Carpenter as long as Spyglass Media has the rights.
paragraphs.cn: 女演员Melissa Barrera表示，她愿意回归《惊声尖叫》，但只要Spyglass Media持有该系列版权，观众就别指望看到她再次出演Sam Carpenter。

paragraphs.en: The Scream 5 and Scream 6 star opened up about what it would take to bring her back to Wes Craven's legendary slasher franchise during an interview with JustWatch . Barrera explained that she still "loves the franchise," but the people overseeing it are what's keeping her from going another round with Ghostface.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受JustWatch采访时，这位《惊声尖叫5》和《惊声尖叫6》主演谈到了自己回归韦斯·克雷文经典砍杀系列的条件。Barrera解释说，她仍然「热爱这个系列」，但负责管理该系列的人，正是阻止她再次面对Ghostface的原因。

paragraphs.en: "Not with the company that currently holds the rights," she said when asked if she would return if she got a call to reprise her role. "I love the franchise. I had an amazing time making those movies, but a lot of the hate and difficulty that I've faced in the last years is because the leadership of that company made it a point to label me something that I'm not."
paragraphs.cn: 当被问到如果收到回归邀约，是否会再次出演这一角色时，她说：「如果版权仍在现在这家公司手里，就不会。我热爱这个系列。拍摄那些电影时我度过了非常美好的时光，但过去几年我遭遇的大量仇恨与困境，源于那家公司的领导层执意给我贴上并不属于我的标签。」

paragraphs.en: "And they never apologized, even when I was proven right. Even with an apology, I wouldn't go back to work with them – not that I'm holding my breath. I don't think they have that ability."
paragraphs.cn: 「而且他们从未道歉过，即使事实证明我是对的。就算他们道歉了，我也不会回去和他们共事——当然，我也没指望他们真的会道歉。我不认为他们有这个能力。」

paragraphs.en: Barrera starred in two installments for the horror franchise and was set to return for a third run with Jenna Ortega but was fired by Spyglass following a series of pro-Palestine social media posts she published in late 2023 . At the time, Spyglass said it has "zero tolerance for antisemitism or the incitement of hate."
paragraphs.cn: Barrera曾出演该恐怖系列的两部作品，原本还计划与Jenna Ortega一同回归第三部，但她在2023年末发布一系列支持巴勒斯坦的社交媒体内容后，被Spyglass解雇。当时，Spyglass表示公司「绝不容忍反犹主义或煽动仇恨的行为」。

paragraphs.en: "I pray day and night for no more deaths, for no more violence, and for peaceful co-existence," Barrera said in a statement following her firing. "I will continue to speak out for those that need it most and continue to advocate for peace and safety, for human rights and freedom. Silence is not an option for me."
paragraphs.cn: Barrera在遭解雇后发表声明说：「我日夜祈祷，不再有人死亡，不再发生暴力，并祈求和平共存。我会继续为最需要帮助的人发声，继续倡导和平与安全、人权与自由。对我来说，沉默不是一种选择。」

paragraphs.en: The Scream rights holder's move was immediately met with backlash from fans for more reasons than one. Barrera had helped bring the franchise back to theaters after a decade without a new installment, and when she was unceremoniously removed as the lead of Scream 7 , other talent happened to follow suit. Jenna Ortega departed Scream 7 just weeks after it all went down. Director Christopher Landon confirmed his exit just one month after Spyglass fired Barrera.
paragraphs.cn: 《惊声尖叫》版权方的这一决定立即引发粉丝反弹，原因不止一个。在长达十年没有推出新作后，Barrera曾帮助该系列重返影院；而当她被毫不客气地撤下《惊声尖叫7》主演位置后，其他主创也相继离开。Jenna Ortega在事件发生几周后退出《惊声尖叫7》，导演Christopher Landon则在Spyglass解雇Barrera一个月后确认离任。

paragraphs.en: Paramount Pictures and Spyglass went on to release a very different vision for the franchise when Scream 7 premiered earlier this year. Although familiar faces helped it break records at the box office , the latest entry debuted to franchise-low reviews, as shared by Rotten Tomatoes . IGN gave it a 6/10 . Scream 8 is also reportedly in the works.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，《惊声尖叫7》上映时，派拉蒙影业与Spyglass为该系列带来了截然不同的构想。尽管熟悉的面孔帮助影片打破了票房纪录，但根据烂番茄的数据，这部最新作品上映后收获了系列最低评价。IGN为其打出6分（满分10分）。据报道，《惊声尖叫8》也在制作中。

paragraphs.en: Despite veering off in a completely new direction, Barrera said now that she's open to coming back. For her, it's not just about working under new management but honoring Craven's legacy.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管该系列已经转向全新的方向，Barrera如今表示自己愿意回归。对她而言，关键不只是与新的管理层共事，也在于尊重Craven留下的遗产。

paragraphs.en: "If the franchise were ever to leave those hands and go into hands that would, I think, honor Wes Craven's legacy more… I think, yeah," she continued regarding her interest in a return to the franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到自己是否有兴趣回归该系列时，她继续说道：「如果这个系列有一天离开他们手中，交到我认为会更尊重韦斯·克雷文遗产的人手里……我想，会的。」

paragraphs.en: For now, Barrera remains uninvolved with Scream. Series star Matthew Lillard recently spoke up about his surprise return in Scream 7. During a recent Q&A (via Deadline ), he said he was "embarrassed" to have reprised his role.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，Barrera仍未参与《惊声尖叫》的制作。该系列主演Matthew Lillard最近谈到了自己意外回归《惊声尖叫7》的经历。他在近期的一场问答活动中表示，自己再次出演这一角色感到「尴尬」。

paragraphs.en: " I’m just gonna say, what happened to Melissa, the whole world didn’t pipe up," he said. "She was like a year early on what the f**k’s going on, but the whole world should have piped up and said, ‘she’s right,’ and they didn’t. And that’s brutal."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我只能说，Melissa遭遇的那些事，当时全世界都没有站出来发声。她大概提前一年就看出了到底他妈发生了什么，但全世界本该站出来说‘她是对的’，可大家没有那么做。这真的很残酷。」

paragraphs.en: For now, Scream 8 has no release date. Although ideas for the next film are something that have been in the works behind the scenes for some time , there's no information about who may show up in it.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，《惊声尖叫8》尚未公布上映日期。虽然下一部电影的构想已经在幕后筹备了一段时间，但目前还没有消息透露哪些人可能会出演。
